source_title: Dr Shriram Nene on Health Span, Lifestyle Habits and Diabetes Prevention - India Today - India Today
source_excerpt:
At the Health Wealth conference following the release of his book '21 Days to Good Health', cardiovascular and thoracic surgeon Dr Shriram Nene addressed preventive healthcare, longevity, health span, and lifestyle habit formation. Dr Nene outlined five pillars of health: nutrition, movement, sleep, stress management, and community connection. The session examined the management of diabetes and heart disease through balanced traditional Indian diets, protein intake, complex carbohydrates, and the elimination of added sugar. Medical discussions evaluated fitness metrics, identifying muscle mass and waist-to-hip ratio as more reliable indicators than body mass index or weighing scales. The panel addressed the limitations of standard blood tests masking conditions like visceral fat, while positioning commercial wearables as supplementary dashboards rather than definitive diagnostic tools. Additionally, the dialogue explored the role of artificial intelligence in supporting clinical workflows, addressing rural healthcare delivery gaps, and managing health data systems without replacing medical practitioners, while advocating a transition from hospital interventions to early home prevention. Kharge Demands Paper Ballots Despite MLC Poll Loss; BJP Questions Congress Record
Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge has called for the reintroduction of paper ballot voting across all elections following the party's performance in recent Member of Legislative Council elections across four states, where Congress secured just one seat out of 28. Prime Minister Narendra Modi targeted the opposition party's electoral record, observing that paper ballots did not assist Congress in Karnataka. Rajya Sabha Member of Parliament John Brittas responded to the Prime Minister's remarks, urging the union government to bring back paper ballots if it believes they do not aid the opposition. Brittas also criticised selective statements on local elections, pointing to recent Kerala local body by-election results.
MLC Poll Debacle: Samajwadi Party Pressures Congress on UP Assembly Seat-Sharing
Following the Uttar Pradesh MLC election results, the Samajwadi Party has urged ally Congress to show generosity in seat-sharing discussions ahead of the assembly elections. The Samajwadi Party secured five seats, defeating the Bharatiya Janata Party in key constituencies such as Varanasi and Lucknow, while the Congress won zero seats. With Congress earlier seeking up to 200 seats, Samajwadi Party leaders stated that the focus must be on winning capability rather than mere seat allocation.
Opposition Meets at Kharge's Residence, Plans Public Impeachment of CEC
Leaders from the INDIA bloc gathered at Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge's residence in New Delhi for a strategy meeting to plan a public impeachment of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The venue was relocated to Kharge's official residence after permissions were reportedly denied for earlier locations, including Hotel Ashoka. The planned public proceedings are structured to reflect parliamentary functioning, with former Lok Sabha Speaker Meira Kumar expected to preside over the session. The meeting was attended by senior opposition figures, including Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, Derek O'Brien, Jairam Ramesh, and John Brittas. Leaders highlighted that representatives from opposition parties and civil society will participate, with motions to be moved and discussed by the Leaders of Opposition from both Houses. The opposition continues to target the Election Commission over electoral integrity concerns ahead of a planned mega rally.
Rahul Gandhi Urges People To Join Chalo Dilli March At Ramlila Maidan
Congress leader Rahul Gandhi has issued a call for the Chalo Dilli protest march scheduled for 1st November at Ramlila Maidan. Describing it as a march for the soul of the country and a Save Democracy initiative, he urged citizens, opposition workers, and student groups across political lines to participate. Addressing the public, he asserted that people should not worry about police lathis and stated that the march aims to protect the Constitution and protest against alleged vote theft. India Today correspondent Moushumi Singh reported that the rally represents an attempt by the India Bloc to build momentum and mobilise public support ahead of a public impeachment planned at Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge's residence. The demonstration is expected to see participation from civil society and opposition party workers arriving from neighbouring states including Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Rajasthan, and Haryana.
